representation_fit.evidence: Brief demands many high-temporality high-density volatile metrics visible at a glance: initial screen (1280x860.png, 1440x900.png) is a 24-tile metric wall (sparkline + status color + value + delta per tile) beside an always-visible timestamped event stream; source/index.html:222-250 defines 24 metrics in 4 groups (medium hierarchy), :254-262 scripts pre-load anomalies (5xx CRIT, DB lag WARN, API p95 excursion) so volatility exists at first paint; no spatial or cross-metric machinery is forced on a low-relation/no-comparison shape; primary object metric and alternate event are both first-class.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Monitoring dominates the first screen: the alert strip is the first content row in both viewports (CRIT 5xx response rate 13.1%, WARN DB replica lag 825 ms), the CRIT/WARN tiles carry red/amber border+tint (source/index.html:74-80, visible in screenshots), and the right panel is the anomaly feed ('16 events · newest first'); no non-monitoring content exists on the page.

time_to_understand.evidence: Top bar self-describes the job — 'PULSEWALL volatile metric stream · monitor' plus clock, '24 metrics · 4 groups', '2 active alerts', 'tick 89' (1280x860.png; source/index.html:148,588-589); group headers summarize '6 metrics · all ok / 1 alert' (source/index.html:353); every tile reads name/value+unit/delta/status at a glance.

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero navigation to the primary object: all 24 tiles render on one screen (source/index.html:68,343-364); one click on a tile opens metric detail (:625), one click on an alert chip does the same (:458), clicking an event traces it directly on the metric (:476,:507-511); Esc/back exits (:176,:626); #m= deep link supported (:501,:637-638).

context_loss.evidence: No route/page change exists; selecting a metric swaps only the right aside while the wall and alert strip stay visible (source/index.html:499-500); detail has an explicit '← Event stream' back control (:176) and Escape (:626); traceEvent scrolls to and flashes the exact change row inside the open detail (:509-510), preserving scan position.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent chrome is one top bar, a conditional alert strip (hidden when no alerts, source/index.html:163,:452), the wall, and one right panel; persistent controls are only pause/1×/4× (:154-158) plus collapsible group heads (:347) — each serves the monitor job (freeze stream to read, accelerate, collapse); everything else on screen is data.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails 4 of 7 checks: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size all 'fail' (measurement-summary.json), consistent with source: 10-11.5px muted #898781 text on #1a1a19 surfaces (source/index.html:30,:84,:92-93), 9.5px chips (:134), compact 3px×10px segmented buttons (:42). Genuine affordances exist — focus-visible outlines (:67,:78), keyboard group toggle (:362), aria-expanded/aria-pressed (:347,:368,:612), prefers-reduced-motion (:139), canvas aria-hidden (:374) — keeping it above 1, but the measured outcomes fail across all a11y categories.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects at either viewport and all three structural checks pass (layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation = 'pass' in measurement-summary.json); both screenshots show clean, untruncated grids at 1280 and 1440. However the 4 failed a11y/type checks are receipt failures implying a concrete remediation pass (palette contrast, target sizes, type floor), plus 1 unattributed warning.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '指标变化可追溯，无闪烁噪声' addressed structurally: every status change/3.5σ jump is recorded per metric (source/index.html:313-323, gate at :319); events display prev→new value plus cause 'threshold crossed → WARN' / 'sudden move 3.9σ' (screenshots; source/index.html:468-475); click-to-trace highlights the exact row in the per-metric change log (:507-511,:525-527); detail chart draws warn/crit hairlines with hover time/value (:547-583). Anti-flicker: 0.45s eased status transitions (:76-77,:82), fade-in event rows (:125-128), tabular numerals (:86), neutral ± dead-band on small deltas (:384-386), prefers-reduced-motion (:139).

scores.overall_note: impl-12 is a single-file dark-mode monitoring wall ('PULSEWALL') that fits the monitor×volatile-evidence-stream cell closely: first paint is fully populated because 90 ticks of seeded history are built synchronously before render (source/index.html:629-636), satisfying the brief's no-loading-state constraint; anomalies are surfaced redundantly (alert strip, status-colored tiles, event stream) in both screenshots; and the acceptance seed is engineered-for via per-metric change logs with prev→value plus cause, click-to-trace with row flash, threshold hairlines, and multiple anti-flicker measures (eased transitions, tabular numerals, a 3.5σ jump gate, a neutral dead-band). Navigation to any metric is 0-1 clicks with context preserved (panel-local swap, back/Esc, #m= deep link), and no layout defects are visible — the three structural receipt checks pass. The clear weakness is accessibility: 4 of 7 checks fail (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size), consistent with the very small muted type and compact controls in source, despite real affordances (focus-visible, keyboard handlers, aria states, reduced-motion). These scores are model-judged proxies on static evidence; task time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this pilot.
